PROCEDURE When_Timer_Expired IS
 V_Item VARCHAR2 (61);
BEGIN
 V_Item := Act.Item;

 IF One_Time_Timer.Get_Value = Const_local.ott_Query THEN
 Goto_Block_and_Query (Const_local.blk_Mainblock);
 Go_Item (V_Item);
 END IF;
END;
